rearContour.purpose: Round the rear quarter into the thigh instead of extending the broad barrel cage down the haunch.

frontContour.preserved: Broad upper shoulders and neck; rounded rear, lower limbs, seat, irons, fenders, saddle and bridle unchanged.
frontContour.purpose: Round the lower chest into the forearms, with the original breastcollar following the same field.
frontContour.contactNote: Preserves the fitted source relationship; zero collar-to-skin gap or penetration is not claimed.
